modalities.name: Traditional Acupuncture & Electro-Acupuncture
modalities.tagline: Restoring energetic balance and stimulating natural healing pathways
modalities.description: Utilizing hair-thin, single-use surgical stainless steel needles inserted into specific meridian points (acupoints) to disperse blockages, regulate the nervous system, and stimulate circulation. Often paired with gentle infra-red heat lamps and optional micro-current electro-stimulation for deeper neurological and muscular rehabilitation.
highlights: Targeted infra-red heat lamp therapy included where indicated
Optional electro-acupuncture for acute or neurological conditions
Rooted in both classical meridian theory and physiological neurology

modalities.name: Chinese Herbal Medicine (中药)
modalities.tagline: Custom botanical formulations tailored to your constitutional diagnosis
modalities.description: Traditional Chinese herbal pharmacology treats the whole person, balancing primary therapeutic botanicals with harmonizing catalysts. Formulated as concentrated water-soluble granules, powders, or capsules for easy daily administration.
highlights: Available in convenient granules, powders, and patent capsules
Regulated herbs sourced from tested, compliant suppliers
Addresses chronic internal disorders, fertility, digestion, and immunity

modalities.name: Huo Guan (Fire Cupping · 火罐)
modalities.tagline: Decompressing muscle tissue, easing myofascial tension, and promoting micro-circulation
modalities.description: Glass cups applied using flame to create a vacuum suction. Cupping pulls stale metabolic waste out of deep muscle layers, opens lymphatic flow, and provides profound relief for persistent neck, shoulder, and lower back tightness.
highlights: Relieves deep myofascial tightness and tension knots
Popular among athletes and desk workers alike

modalities.name: Gua Sha Scraping Therapy (刮痧)
modalities.tagline: Releasing micro-circulatory blood stagnation and respiratory congestion
modalities.description: A traditional scraping technique using a smooth-edged jade or buffalo horn instrument along muscle lines. Stimulates immune response, releases chronic fascia adhesions, and clears stagnation.
highlights: Rapidly clears tension headaches and stiff necks
Effective during early-stage colds and respiratory tightness

modalities.name: Traditional Medical Massage & Tuina
modalities.tagline: Acupressure and rhythmic mobilization to realign joints and meridians
modalities.description: Targeted clinical bodywork employing pressure along meridian pathways to mobilize joints, alleviate soft-tissue trauma, and enhance blood flow. Extended hours are available on Mondays and Saturdays specifically for massage.
highlights: Special weekend and evening appointment availability
Complements acupuncture for severe orthopedic rehabilitation
Non-needle option for sensitive patients and children
